name: facturacion-electronica-cr
description: Simulador educativo de comprobantes electrónicos de Costa Rica (Anexos y Estructuras v4.4). No envía comprobantes reales.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w supabase && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w supabase
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w supabase
scripts.supabase:desplegar: npm run build -w supabase && npx supabase@latest db push && npx supabase@latest functions deploy api
